recipes.title: Middle Eastern kofta and potato bake, light
recipes.summary: Baked beef kofta with potatoes, zucchini and tomatoes, served with a lemony tahini yogurt sauce. Extra vegetables and less oil keep this Middle Eastern dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Prepare the potato, zucchini, onion and garlic in their listed forms.
Mix the ground beef with the onion, garlic, cumin, paprika and salt until evenly seasoned.
Shape the ground beef mixture into small oval kofta.
Coat the potato and zucchini with the olive oil.
Arrange the potato and zucchini across a large baking dish.
Pour the tomatoes, canned, evenly over the vegetables.
Place the kofta over the vegetables without crowding them.
Bake until the kofta are cooked through and the potato is tender and golden.
Whisk the greek yogurt, tahini and lemon juice into a smooth sauce.
Rest the kofta and potato bake so the pan juices settle.
Serve the Middle Eastern kofta and potato bake with the yogurt sauce.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the bake and yogurt sauce separately for up to 3 days. Reheat the kofta and vegetables covered until steaming. Freeze the bake without the sauce for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Huevos rancheros, light
recipes.summary: Eggs, black beans and warm tomato-pepper salsa served over tortillas with a little cheddar and sour cream. Extra vegetables keep this high-protein Mexican breakfast lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the onion, bell pepper, garlic and spring onions in their listed forms.
Heat the olive oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and bell pepper until soft and lightly golden.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and stir until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, and simmer until the salsa is thick and spoonable.
Warm the black beans in a small saucepan until steaming.
Toast the tortilla in a dry pan until warm and flexible.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks remain tender.
Place the tortilla on serving plates.
Spread the black beans over the tortilla.
Top the black beans with the eggs.
Spoon the tomato salsa around the eggs and add the cheddar cheese and sour cream.
Finish the huevos rancheros with the spring onions.

recipes.storageNotes: Best assembled immediately. Refrigerate the salsa and black beans separately for up to 3 days. Cook fresh eggs and toast fresh tortillas when serving again. Do not freeze the finished dish.

recipes.title: Brazilian black bean stew with rice, light
recipes.summary: Black beans, sweet potato, squash and peppers simmered in a savoury tomato broth and served with rice. Extra vegetables and less rice and oil keep this vegan lunch lighter.

steps.instruction: Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Prepare the sweet potato, butternut squash, bell pepper, onion, garlic, lime and cilantro in their listed forms.
Cook the white rice until tender, then keep it covered so the grains finish steaming.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and bell pepper until soft and lightly golden.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and stir until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, vegetable broth, sweet potato and butternut squash.
Simmer the stew until the sweet potato and butternut squash are tender.
Stir in the black beans and simmer until the broth thickens slightly.
Fold the cilantro through the black bean stew.
Squeeze the lime over the stew.
Rest the Brazilian black bean stew before serving it with the white rice.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the stew and rice separately for up to 4 days. Reheat with a splash of vegetable broth. Freeze the stew without the rice for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Ethiopian lentil and spinach stew, light
recipes.summary: Red lentils and spinach simmered with slowly cooked onion, tomatoes, ginger, cumin and paprika. Less rice and oil keep this vegetarian Ethiopian dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Rinse the red lentils under cold water until the water runs clear.
Prepare the onion, garlic, ginger and spinach in their listed forms.
Cook the white rice until tender, then keep it covered so the grains finish steaming.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Cook the onion slowly until very soft and deeply golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika and tomato paste and stir until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, vegetable broth, red lentils and salt.
Simmer the stew until the red lentils are tender and the sauce is thick.
Fold the spinach into the lentil stew until wilted.
Rest the Ethiopian lentil and spinach stew so the flavours settle.
Serve the stew with the white rice.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the stew and rice separately for up to 4 days. Reheat with extra vegetable broth if needed. Freeze the stew for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Peruvian quinoa milk porridge, light
recipes.summary: Creamy quinoa simmered with milk, cinnamon and ripe banana in a simple Peruvian-style breakfast porridge. Less quinoa and sugar keep this version light.

steps.instruction: Rinse the quinoa under cold water until the water runs clear.
Slice the banana into small rounds.
Simmer the quinoa with the water until the grains are tender and their spirals are visible.
Pour the whole milk into the cooked quinoa.
Simmer the porridge until creamy and spoonable.
Stir the cinnamon and brown sugar through the porridge.
Fold the banana into the warm quinoa porridge.
Rest the Peruvian quinoa milk porridge before serving.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 3 days and reheat gently with extra whole milk or water. The banana softens during storage. Freezing is not recommended.
